```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

utils_candidates <- c(
  file.path(dirname(tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) "")), "_vpro_report_utils.R"),
  file.path(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""), "reports", "_vpro_report_utils.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "reports", "_vpro_report_utils.R")
)
utils_candidates <- utils_candidates[nzchar(utils_candidates)]
utils_path <- utils_candidates[file.exists(utils_candidates)][1]
if (!nzchar(utils_path)) stop("Unable to locate reports/_vpro_report_utils.R")
source(utils_path)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
project_root <- params$project_root
db_root <- ""
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_candidate <- tryCatch(normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(db_candidate)) {
    db_path <- db_candidate
    db_root <- dirname(dirname(db_candidate))
  }
}
root_candidates <- c(
  if (!is.null(project_root)) project_root else "",
  db_root,
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))

parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lists")
  tbls <- c("Sample_Env", "Sample_SU", "Sample_Humus", "Sample_Mineral", "vw_USysAllVeg", "LayerCode")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
  list_files <- c(
    "lists_MasterSiteUnitList.parquet" = "VLists.MasterSiteUnitList",
    "lists_USysAllSpecs.parquet" = "VLists.USysAllSpecs",
    "lists_LifeformCodes.parquet" = "VLists.LifeformCodes"
  )
  for (file_name in names(list_files)) {
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", list_files[[file_name]], gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  con <- vpro_duckdb_connect(db_path, root_dir = root_dir, read_only = TRUE, attach_lists = TRUE)
}

aspect_to_text <- function(value_in) {
  if (is.na(value_in)) return(NA_character_)
  if (value_in >= 11.25 && value_in < 33.75) return("NNE")
  if (value_in >= 33.75 && value_in < 56.25) return("NE")
  if (value_in >= 56.25 && value_in < 78.75) return("ENE")
  if (value_in >= 78.75 && value_in < 101.25) return("E")
  if (value_in >= 101.25 && value_in < 123.75) return("ESE")
  if (value_in >= 123.75 && value_in < 146.25) return("SE")
  if (value_in >= 146.25 && value_in < 168.75) return("SSE")
  if (value_in >= 168.75 && value_in < 191.25) return("S")
  if (value_in >= 191.25 && value_in < 213.75) return("SSW")
  if (value_in >= 213.75 && value_in < 236.25) return("SW")
  if (value_in >= 236.25 && value_in < 258.75) return("WSW")
  if (value_in >= 258.75 && value_in < 281.25) return("W")
  if (value_in >= 281.25 && value_in < 303.75) return("WNW")
  if (value_in >= 303.75 && value_in < 326.25) return("NW")
  if (value_in >= 326.25 && value_in < 348.75) return("NNW")
  if (value_in >= 348.75 && value_in <= 360) return("N")
  if (value_in >= 0 && value_in < 11.25) return("N")
  if (value_in == 999) return("Level")
  "???"
}

smr_class_code <- function(code) {
  switch(
    as.character(code),
    "0" = "VX",
    "1" = "X",
    "2" = "SX",
    "3" = "SM",
    "4" = "M",
    "5" = "SHG",
    "6" = "HG",
    "7" = "SHD",
    "8" = "HD",
    ""
  )
}

lifeform_code_to_desc <- function(code) {
  switch(
    as.character(code),
    "0" = "Genus-level and mixed",
    "1" = "Coniferous Tree",
    "2" = "Deciduous Tree",
    "3" = "Evergreen Shrub",
    "4" = "Deciduous Shrub",
    "5" = "Ferns or Fern-ally",
    "6" = "Graminoid",
    "7" = "Forb",
    "8" = "Parasite or Saprophyte",
    "9" = "Moss",
    "10" = "Liverwort",
    "11" = "Lichen",
    "12" = "Dwarf woody plant",
    "13" = "Macroalgae",
    ""
  )
}

format_class_summary <- function(values, label_fn = NULL) {
  vals <- values[!is.na(values) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(values)))]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  vals <- as.character(vals)
  if (!is.null(label_fn)) {
    vals <- vapply(vals, label_fn, character(1))
  }
  counts <- sort(table(vals))
  parts <- paste0(names(counts), "(", as.integer(counts), ")")
  parts <- paste(parts, collapse = "  ")
  nulls <- sum(is.na(values) | !nzchar(trimws(as.character(values))))
  if (nulls > 0) {
    parts <- paste0(parts, "  (Null ", nulls, ")")
  }
  trimws(parts)
}

format_numeric_summary <- function(values, digits = 1) {
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(values))
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  min_val <- round(min(vals), digits)
  avg_val <- round(mean(vals), digits)
  max_val <- round(max(vals), digits)
  parts <- paste0(min_val, "---", avg_val, "---", max_val)
  nulls <- sum(is.na(values) | !nzchar(trimws(as.character(values))))
  if (nulls > 0) {
    parts <- paste0(parts, "  (Null ", nulls, ")")
  }
  parts
}

apply_theme <- isTRUE(params$apply_theme)
colour_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$colour_greater))
gray_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$gray_greater))

style_report_table <- function(df, columns = NULL) {
  if (!apply_theme || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  style_numeric <- function(vec) {
    labels <- as.character(vec)
    vapply(seq_along(labels), function(i) {
      label <- labels[[i]]
      if (!nzchar(label)) return("")
      num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(label))
      if (is.na(num)) return(label)
      bg <- ""
      if (!is.na(gray_greater) && num >= gray_greater) {
        bg <- "#e6e6e6"
      } else if (!is.na(colour_greater) && num >= colour_greater) {
        bg <- "#f9e27d"
      }
      if (nzchar(bg)) cell_spec(label, background = bg) else label
    }, character(1))
  }
  target_cols <- columns
  if (is.null(target_cols) || length(target_cols) == 0) {
    target_cols <- names(df)[vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))]
  }
  target_cols <- intersect(target_cols, names(df))
  for (col_name in target_cols) {
    df[[col_name]] <- style_numeric(df[[col_name]])
  }
  df
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
plots <- parse_plot_numbers(params$plot_number, params$plot_numbers)
plots <- plots[nzchar(plots)]

if (length(plots) == 0 && nzchar(trimws(params$site_unit)) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_SU")) {
  su_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT PlotNumber FROM Sample_SU WHERE SiteUnit = ?",
    list(trimws(params$site_unit))
  )
  plots <- unique(as.character(su_df$PlotNumber))
}

if (length(plots) == 0 && nzchar(trimws(params$project_id)) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Env")) {
  env_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT PlotNumber FROM Sample_Env WHERE ProjectID = ?",
    list(trimws(params$project_id))
  )
  plots <- unique(as.character(env_df$PlotNumber))
}

plots <- plots[nzchar(plots)]

env_data <- data.frame()
su_data <- data.frame()
humus_data <- data.frame()
mineral_data <- data.frame()

if (length(plots) > 0 && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Env")) {
  plot_sql <- paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, plots), collapse = ", ")
  env_sql <- sprintf("SELECT * FROM Sample_Env WHERE PlotNumber IN (%s)", plot_sql)
  env_data <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, env_sql)
}

if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_SU")) {
  if (length(plots) > 0) {
    plot_sql <- paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, plots), collapse = ", ")
    su_sql <- sprintf("SELECT PlotNumber, SiteUnit FROM Sample_SU WHERE PlotNumber IN (%s)", plot_sql)
    su_data <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, su_sql)

    su_data <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
      con,
      "SELECT PlotNumber, SiteUnit FROM Sample_SU WHERE SiteUnit = ?",
      list(trimws(params$site_unit))
    )
  }
}

if (nrow(env_data) == 0 && nzchar(trimws(params$site_unit)) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Env")) {
  env_data <- DBI::dbGetQuery(

    "SELECT * FROM Sample_Env WHERE PlotNumber IN (SELECT PlotNumber FROM Sample_SU WHERE SiteUnit = ?)",

if (length(plots) > 0 && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Humus")) {

}

if (length(plots) > 0 && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Mineral")) {

  mineral_sql <- sprintf("SELECT * FROM Sample_Mineral WHERE PlotNumber IN (%s)", plot_sql)

}

if (nrow(su_data) == 0 && nrow(env_data) > 0 && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_SU")) {
  plot_col <- vpro_first_existing_col(env_data, c("PlotNumber", "plotnumber"))
  if (!is.na(plot_col)) {
    env_plots <- unique(as.character(env_data[[plot_col]]))
    plot_sql <- vpro_sql_in_list(con, env_plots)

      su_sql <- sprintf("SELECT PlotNumber, SiteUnit FROM Sample_SU WHERE PlotNumber IN (%s)", plot_sql)
      su_data <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, su_sql)
    }
  }
}

if (nrow(env_data) > 0) {

}
if (nrow(su_data) > 0) {

site_unit_overview <- data.frame()

    overview$siteserieslongname <- ""
  }
  site_unit_overview <- overview %>%
    arrange(siteunit) %>%
    mutate(siteserieslongname = ifelse(is.na(siteserieslongname), "", siteserieslongname))

env_active <- env_data
```

```{r summaries, echo=FALSE}
summary_rows <- list()

add_summary <- function(label, value) {
  if (!is.null(value) && nzchar(trimws(as.character(value)))) {
    summary_rows[[length(summary_rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(Metric = label, Summary = value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}

if (nrow(env_active) > 0) {
  cols <- names(env_active)
  env_col <- function(...) {
    candidates <- tolower(c(...))
    hit <- candidates[candidates %in% cols]
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(env_active[[hit[1]]])
    NULL
  }
  exposure1 <- env_col("exposure1")
  if (!is.null(exposure1)) {
    add_summary("Exposure 1", format_class_summary(exposure1))
  }
  exposure2 <- env_col("exposure2")
  if (!is.null(exposure2)) {
    add_summary("Exposure 2", format_class_summary(exposure2))
  }
  disturbance1 <- env_col("sitedisturbance1")
  if (!is.null(disturbance1)) {
    add_summary("Site Disturbance 1", format_class_summary(disturbance1))
  }
  disturbance2 <- env_col("sitedisturbance2")
  if (!is.null(disturbance2)) {
    add_summary("Site Disturbance 2", format_class_summary(disturbance2))

if (length(summary_rows) > 0) {
  summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_rows)
  summary_df <- style_report_table(summary_df)
  kbl(summary_df, escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No environment summaries available.")
}
```

## Lifeform Cover Summary

```{r lifeform-summary, echo=FALSE}
if (plots_in_unit > 0 && nrow(veg) > 0 && "species_lifeform" %in% names(veg)) {
  veg_lf <- veg %>%
    mutate(species_lifeform = as.character(species_lifeform)) %>%
    group_by(plotnumber, species_lifeform) %>%
    summarize(cover = sum(cover_num, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  lf_summary <- veg_lf %>%
    group_by(species_lifeform) %>%
    summarize(
      plots_with_cover = sum(cover > 0),
      min_cover = ifelse(plots_with_cover >= plots_in_unit, min(cover), 0),
      avg_cover = sum(cover) / plots_in_unit,
      max_cover = max(cover),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  lf_summary$lifeform_desc <- lifeform_code_to_desc(lf_summary$species_lifeform)
  if (nrow(lifeform_labels) > 0) {
    lf_summary <- lf_summary %>%
      left_join(lifeform_labels, by = c("species_lifeform" = "lifeform"))
    lf_summary$lifeform_desc <- ifelse(
      nzchar(lf_summary$lifeformdescription),
      lf_summary$lifeformdescription,
      lf_summary$lifeform_desc
    )
  }

  lf_summary <- lf_summary %>%
    arrange(species_lifeform) %>%
    transmute(
      Lifeform = ifelse(nzchar(lifeform_desc), lifeform_desc, species_lifeform),
      Min = round(min_cover, 1),
      Avg = round(avg_cover, 1),
      Max = round(max_cover, 1)
    )

  lf_summary <- style_report_table(lf_summary, columns = c("Min", "Avg", "Max"))
  kbl(lf_summary, escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No lifeform cover data available.")
}
```

## Strata Cover Summary

```{r strata-summary, echo=FALSE}
if (nrow(env_active) > 0) {
  strata_map <- c(
    "Tree" = "stratacovertree",
    "Shrub" = "stratacovershrub",
    "Herb" = "stratacoverherb",
    "Moss" = "stratacovermoss"
  )
  strata_cols <- names(strata_map)[strata_map %in% names(env_active)]
  if (length(strata_cols) > 0) {
    strata_rows <- lapply(strata_cols, function(label) {
      col_name <- strata_map[[label]]
      data.frame(
        Strata = label,
        Summary = format_numeric_summary(env_active[[col_name]], digits = 1),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
    strata_df <- do.call(rbind, strata_rows)
    strata_df <- style_report_table(strata_df)
    kbl(strata_df, escape = !apply_theme) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No strata cover fields found.")
  }
} else {
  cat("No strata cover data available.")
}
```
